case.summary: Transaction 3523199 ($100.07) was flagged by the real-time model at 0.54 for card-not-present activity on a new device. Customer validation confirmed the purchase was unauthorized. The card has been blocked and the transaction declined.

R1, R4: Decline unauthorized online transaction from a new device profile following customer denial.
R1, R4: Block compromised card C02923-K1 (exposure $100.07 <= $2500) due to confirmed card-not-present new device fraud.
Policy requires maintaining the open case for investigation tracking and audit trails.
Not applicable here; case is closed as confirmed fraud (Policy Section 6).

sar.reason: Exposure is $100.07 (does not exceed $1,000 threshold), no shared fraud ring identified, and pattern is standard card_not_present_new_device rather than coordinated or undocumented.

stop_reason: Investigation concludes per Policy Section 6 after customer confirmation of fraud, transaction decline, card blocking, and case finalization.
